summary: Eason Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a securities purchase agreement for a private placement of up to 2,000,000 units at $1.00 per unit, each unit comprising 60,000 restricted class A ordinary shares and a warrant to purchase 60,000 ordinary shares, for gross proceeds of $2 million. The warrants are exercisable immediately at $1.00 per 60,000 shares, expire in three years, and include full-ratchet anti-dilution and a mandatory exercise right if ADSs reach $5.00 for 20 consecutive days. Proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation. No premium, tender, or structural change applies.
